educationalGoal: Voice actors and announcers have techniques to appropriately express themselves using voice. The ability to speak better to others is an important skill, even for ordinary people. In this course, you will acquire better presentation skills through exercises where the speaker communicates with the other party. Students will also learn the first steps of acoustic informatics by recording, visualizing, and playing back sound through computer processing. Students will be able to improve their self-introductions, etc. from a scientific and emotional standpoint.
advice: In this course, as the first step in voice acting skills, the following items will be covered as the scientific foundations of communication that all speakers should acquire. You will learn speech-chain, anatomy, informatics, and psychology. In the end of the course, you will submit presentation materials (recordings) as a work assignment. People communicate by transmitting words and emotions created in the brain by the speaker to the outside of the body as acoustic signals in the air by moving anatomical organs. You will learn the names and mechanisms of speech organs such as the vocal cords, larynx, and tongue, which have recently attracted the attention of voice actors, announcers, and singers. I would like you to understand the professional speech generation technology, phonetics and anatomy. In addition, students will learn how to record and display speech. Finally, I would like you to create your own recorded presentation materials so that you can use your own mind to make better presentations in other subjects. In addition, by creating a report on the evaluation of presentation materials as a team, students will acquire the ability to objectively evaluate them.
requiredKnowledge: Nothing in particular - Japanese - Presentation material creation

activityGoals.body: You can be aware of "good speech" that professional voice actors are also aware of.
You can understand the academic basis of speech.
You can record your own self-introduction presentation and then assess yourself.
You can improve your own speech depending on expectations.
You can grasp their emotions in addition to understanding the meaning.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Grasp the importance of one's own body, physical phenomena, and communicating to others in verbal communication, and be able to explain specific practice methods. 2. Understand how to use one's own body in verbal communication. 3. You can think logically about voice communication, organize it, and convey it in an easy-to-understand manner. 4. You can record your own self-introduction presentation and then assess yourself. 5. Understand goals and improve self-introductions for yourself and others.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. You understand the importance of one's own body, physical phenomena in verbal communication. 2. You know how to use one's body in verbal communication. 3. You can think logically about voice communication, organize it, and convey it appropriately. 4. You can think logically about speech communication, organize it, and then communicate it appropriately. 5. You can understand goals and have better verbal communication in self-presentation for others.
